static_traits.name: Li Man
static_traits.family_status: Has two children，居住在路易斯安那州，信仰印度教；Mother擅长烘焙
static_traits.social_status: 拥有支持性的Mother和一些朋友，但对表达内疚与自责有所犹豫
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness史；既往not yet接受心理治疗或心理问题相关处理
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性尚可；语气消极，常以自责与失败标签描述自我；能Identify automatic thoughts并尝试更平衡的表述；配合度较好

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己是个糟糕的妻子，因为我Has two children却离婚了，这种思维导致内疚与自责。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of guilt and self-blame have begun to affect my academic performance and daily functioning.
growth_experiences: Two years ago she went through a divorce; the breakup of the marriage and family brought high pressure and strong emotions; since then she has long been troubled by guilt and self-blame, persistently believing she failed in the marriage, affecting self-esteem and overall mood, in turn interfering with academic performance, daily tasks and self-care, and leading to difficulties in building new interpersonal/intimate relationships.

special_situations.event: 回想离婚与过去的婚姻经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能维持婚姻，就证明我作为伴侣是失败的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Buries my energy in studies and uses self-criticism to 'supervise' myself to make up for failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我就是个糟糕的妻子/I am a failure

special_situations.event: Trying to build new relationships or talk to others about the divorce
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人知道我离过婚，他们会看not起我或拒绝我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing与自我暴露，减少与亲友深入交流
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我not配、not值得信任

special_situations.event: 面临Academic pressure或注意到成绩受影响时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的学业not够完美，就说明I am worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍学习、埋头做任务以控制Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My life is going downhill; I will keep failing forever

special_situations.event: 与孩子相处时想到家庭破裂
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the child is affected by the divorce, it is all my personal fault
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessive self-blame, compensating for perceived indebtedness through more companionship
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I made the child suffer; this is my responsibility

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被视为称职且被接纳的伴侣与Mother，拥有稳定的亲密关系与自我价值感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕再次被评判为失败、Being rejected，担心伤害孩子或重演关系破裂
defense_goal: 通过回避新关系与Suppressing expression来降低被评判与Being rejected的风险
Maintains a sense of control and compensates for feelings of failure through self-criticism

object_relations.object_representation: Others (potential partners, family and friends) are critics/judges

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When considering building a new relationship or confiding about the divorce experience
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为对方会像社会或前任那样评判自己（移情：将自我羞耻Projection到他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use含糊与保留的语气，降低自我披露，避免深入探讨感受，转向中性话题或结束对话。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to weigh positive and negative evidence and try a more balanced self-statement
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将重构视为“在为自己找借口”，担心这会使自己变得not负责任
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 强调离婚是决定性证据，use“应该/必须”的僵化句式negate积极例证；语气严苛、坚持自我指责立场。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about divorce and children and emotions well up
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes expressing emotion will burden others or make them lose control, so emotion and aggression are turned back onto the self
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自我贬损、道歉式语言表达；避免指认外部因素与现实限制，Reinforcement自责并结束话题。

manifestations: 离婚后长期感到羞耻与失败，犹豫向支持系统（Mother与朋友）表达情绪
Hard to build new relationships, worries about being judged and rejected

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection with excessive self-restriction and reproach, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently labeling oneself as 'failure / bad wife'
Overly concerned about others' possible evaluations, reducing self-disclosure and help-seeking

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy originally meant to be directed outward back onto themselves, restraining expression or seeking help from others.
manifestations: 感到羞耻而not与Mother和朋友谈及内疚与自责
通过加倍投入学业来Repression情绪、独自承担

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 认为他人会看not起自己（离过婚、Has two children）
担心在新关系中Being rejected或评判而回避接触

exception_events.target_problem: 在Reflection离婚与过往关系时，来访者通常会陷入“I am a failure/糟糕的妻子”的反刍，Low mood并难以专注学习。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在与孩子相处的某些时刻，来访者not yet陷入自责，能够体验到“我是个好妈妈”的感受，并与孩子产生更投入的连接。
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同情境与关注点——将注意力放在孩子的即时需求与互动上，出现正向体验与价值感，从而短时偏离失败叙事。

exception_events.target_problem: 在Academic pressure情境下，来访者通常因负性自我评价而注意力涣散、表现下降。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 来访者在部分课程中表现Good并获得积极反馈，体验到成就感。
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同做法——投入于具体任务、获得正向反馈；尽管情绪困扰存在，但任务清晰与投入度提升促成了更好结果。

positive_force: Has a supportive mother and friends（潜在支持网络）
在部分课程中已有Good表现，具备学习投入与获得反馈的能力
Can experience 'good mother' moments and a sense of value in close interactions with the child
愿意尝试更平衡的自我表述与认知重构（如“我尽力了，但have not成功”）
negative_force: Rigid self-labeling and overgeneralization (equating divorce with total failure)
内疚与自责维持反刍，negate积极证据与体验
Mind reading of others' evaluations and negative predictions, leading to avoidance of new relationships and help-seeking
Impaired self-esteem与羞耻感强，降低自我接纳与表达
在Academic pressure下灾难化与负性Anticipation，注意力与功能受损

target_behavior.behavior: 反复的自我标签化与内疚自责的反刍（“I am a failure/糟糕的妻子”）
antecedent: 面临Academic pressure或注意到成绩受影响
Trying to build new relationships or discuss the divorce with others
When with her children, thinks about the family breakdown and what she owes
target_behavior.core_reason: 将离婚视为对自我价值的全盘negate，伴随灾难化、过度概括、读心与negate积极等认知偏差维持失败叙事。
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定与外界评判，获得短期的控制感与自我惩罚式的“补偿”，同时避免再度受伤。
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem与Low mood；学业与日常任务执行受阻；人际回避、难以建立新关系。
